messages:
Maria (PM): Quick proposal — small, staged rollout for the Optimize Toolkit v1. Plan is: 1) Recommendations API (batching / caching / quant recs) 2) Eval-triggered alerts (config-driven) 3) Ops + admin controls/UI. Target: two pilot customers in ~8 weeks. TL;DR: lightweight config API + per-tenant thresholds. Details below.

Aj (Eng): Perf targets? p95/p99 goals + expected throughput/cost assumptions?

Maria (PM): Good Q. Acceptance: keep model-serving p95 <= 1.2x current for typical inference paths; aim for 20% unit-cost reduction for pilot workloads that adopt recs. No more than 5% customer-visible regressions in first month.

Vikram (EngRuntime): Runtime notes: quantization support differs by model family. We need a fallback chain and a `quality_tier` param (`high|medium|low`) so server picks quant/model variant. Suggest default continuous batching window = 5ms, but configurable per-route. Long-tail sequences will blow memory if we batch too aggressively.

Sana (DataSci): For eval-alerts I propose we surface: concordance (top-k agreement), perplexity drift, and generation rejection rate. Thresholds should be tenant-customizable. Example config snippet: 
```
eval_alert:
  name: "concordance_drop"
  metric: "concordance"
  threshold: 0.85
  lookback: "7d"
  notify: ["ops", "product"]
  severity: "warning"
```
This can be evaluated daily and map to notification + auto-rollback gates.

Jess (Design): UX asks: admins need an obvious mute/unmute, a preview diff (before alerts fire), and a historical trend chart per metric. Can provide a simple mock if we pick the metric set.

Maria (PM): Mock link (Figma) posted in thread — will DM. Pilot tenants: AcmeHealth and Notesly (small/med SaaS). Rollback plan: auto-fallback to 'compat' model variant + pause alerts + flag to force previous quant.

Aj (Eng): Rollout gating idea: tenant feature-flag + canary to 5% traffic first, then 25% after 48h, and 100% after health checks. Need perf test harness against pilot traffic profiles.

Vikram (EngRuntime): Agreed. Also require telemetry tags: `rec_variant`, `quant_level`, `cache_hit` on every request for attribution. Ops needs those for cost breakdown.

ops-bot: Staging deploy scheduled at 1745560000 :robot_face:

Maria (PM): Action items — Aj: perf plan & harness (due Thu). Vikram: fallback chain + telemetry contract (due Mon). Sana: pilot eval thresholds & sample datasets (due Fri). Jess: admin UI mock + mute/preview flows (due Wed). I'll coordinate pilot invites. :+1:

Aj (Eng): I'll start load profiles today and sketch the perf SLA matrix.

Vikram (EngRuntime): I'll write the fallback POC and add `quality_tier` to the API draft.

Sana (DataSci): I'll prepare initial thresholds and a small eval runner for pilot datasets.

Jess (Design): Will share mocks by Wed EOD.
